sources.title: Free AI Token Counter - GPT, Claude & Gemini Token Calculator - MiniWebtool
sources.snippet: AI Token Counter - Estimate how much model context your prompt may use with MiniWebtool’s AI Token Counter. Counts update while you type, alongside a token visualization and word and character totals; estimates cover several popular model families.

sources.title: Track model usage - Databricks on AWS
sources.snippet: Track model usage Monitor usage for Unity Gateway services with the system.ai_gateway.usage system table. It captures requests to model services, model provider services, and MCP services from various sources, including AI Query, coding agents, Databricks Apps, AI Playground, and other applications.
